name: jev
description: Per-turn effort routing and subagent model routing with TypeSafe's Jev. Off by default; turn it on for a session with /jev.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai (console.typesafe.ai/keys). Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or JEV_API_KEY from the environment.

judgment_model.title: Model for judgment subagents
judgment_model.description: Subagents doing review, verification, design, or root-cause debugging run on this model alias.

delegated_model.title: Model for delegated subagents
delegated_model.description: Subagents doing well-scoped implementation, research, search, or mechanical edits run on this model alias.

route_subagents.title: Route subagent models
route_subagents.description: Rewrite each Agent call's model while /jev is on. Turn off to route effort only.
